notes: NODE-RPI4-01 core applies this to every core/task/request after registry checks. First matching rule wins; no match uses default_approval.
origin comes from parameters.origin. A request without it is 'unspecified' and always needs UI approval.
context_rule tasks are created by core itself from context-rules.json and skip the source node check.
User decision 2026-10-21: direct commands (voice parser, phone app) and quiet mode run at once; LLM proposals, opening the entrance door and the three home scenarios need UI approval.

Decision 2026-10-22 (policy_version 2): a waiting task may also be approved from the phone (pfn/v1/mobile/task/action, written only by homemind-mobile-api), except when its rule has phone_may_approve false (opening the entrance door: approved on the 7-inch screen in the house). Core refuses approve and resume of such a task from the phone; reject and cancel stay allowed.

User decision 2026-10-24 (policy_version 3): a task waiting for approval (state proposed) expires after proposal_ttl_seconds (the rule's value, else the top-level default): core closes it as rejected with PROPOSAL_EXPIRED and refuses a later approve. 600 s for proposals in general, 120 s for opening the entrance door (approved by someone at the door, not hours later).

rejection_codes.DEVICE_UNKNOWN: target device is not in device-registry.json
rejection_codes.DEVICE_NOT_WIRED: target device wiring_status is not wired
rejection_codes.CAPABILITY_NOT_ALLOWED: action is not a capability of the target device
rejection_codes.PARAMETERS_INVALID: command parameters do not satisfy command.schema.json
rejection_codes.POSITION_NOT_REGISTERED: servo angle is not a registered open/closed position
rejection_codes.PROPOSAL_EXPIRED: the task waited for approval longer than its proposal_ttl_seconds
